en.sayed-ali-raza: As for your saying that both of us are sons of ‘Abd Manāf, it is no doubt so,
but Umayyah cannot be like Hāshim, nor Ḥarb like ‘Abd al-Muṭṭalib, nor can Abū Sufyān be like Abū Ṭālib.

The muhājir (immigrant) cannot be a match for him who was set free (on the day of fall of Mecca), nor can one of pure descent be a match for him who has been adopted, nor the pursuer of truth be a match of the adherent to wrong, nor a believer be a match for a hypocrite.
How bad are the successors who go on following their predecessors who have fallen in the fire of Hell!
